# Lorica - Traditional Catholic Prayers, 12 Novenas & Spiritual Armor

Welcome to **Lorica** (https://loricaprayers.com), an ad-free Catholic spiritual sanctuary providing studio audio narrations, 12 complete 9-day novenas with Holy Rosary decades, loopable night protection psalms, and an Examination of Conscience for Confession.

## Key Features & Capabilities

- **Audio Prayers & Night Loops**: Studio vocal narrations with loopable Catholic prayers including Psalm 91, St. Michael Archangel prayer, and Night Compline.
- **12 Catholic Novenas**: 9-day devotions including Surrender Novena, St. Jude, Divine Mercy, Our Lady Undoer of Knots, St. Joseph, and St. Therese.
- **Confession Helper**: Catholic Examination of Conscience organized by the Ten Commandments and the Seven Capital Sins.
- **73-Book Roman Catholic Bible**: Douay-Rheims scripture reader with cross-references.
- **Liturgical Calendar**: Real-time Catholic feast day calculations and daily seasonal vigils.
